home.bio: I build user-focused, production-ready iOS applications with Swift and SwiftUI. My backend and security experience helps me design authentication, real-time communication, and scalable services with the complete product in mind.

about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm an iOS and macOS engineer with experience shipping production Apple-platform applications using Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit. I also build backend systems with Spring Boot and Node.js, working across authentication, real-time communication, encrypted data, containerized deployments, and CI/CD. My engineering approach centers on clean architecture, security, and maintainable software.

bullets: Built AIChat, a native macOS client with SwiftUI, real-time streaming, multimodal attachments, and persistent conversation management.
Architected a provider-independent, protocol-oriented design and extracted reusable capabilities into AIChatSDK.
Integrated OpenAI-compatible services using SSE and implemented Core Data persistence.
Implemented Google OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and secured tokens and API keys in Keychain.
Developed a sandbox-compliant Git Code Mode with sensitive-data masking and user-approved edits.
Added on-device speech-to-text and text-to-speech using Speech and AVFoundation.
Developed a full-stack application using Angular for the frontend and Node.js for the backend.
Built real-time communication infrastructure using WebSocket and Socket.IO.
Designed a document search system using Elasticsearch for full-text search across PDF files.
Implemented end-to-end encryption (E2EE) using AES-GCM and ECDH key exchange.
Containerized services with Docker and configured development environments.
Implemented practical exercises in network security and secure communication protocols.
Developed SSL control mechanisms for secure communication.
Developed high-performance, scalable mobile applications using Swift.
Designed user-focused interfaces using SwiftUI and UIKit.
Built applications with MVVM and MVC architectural patterns.
Implemented data management and performance optimizations using CoreData and Realm.
Contributed to the full App Store deployment and release lifecycle.

project_detail.lead: A developer-focused AI application that combines a native macOS experience, provider-independent AI chat, and secure Git project analysis in one modular Swift SDK.
project_detail.overview_title: Chat, voice, and code in one app
project_detail.overview: AIChat is a native macOS application for real-time communication with OpenAI-compatible AI services. It includes multi-conversation management, persistent history, Markdown and code blocks, file attachments, voice conversations, and local Git repository inspection. Its core capabilities are modularized in AIChatSDK for reuse by other macOS applications.

project_detail.architecture: A layered architecture with one-way dependencies keeps the UI from directly accessing URLSession, Core Data, Keychain, or Git infrastructure. Provider-independent integrations and protocol-based boundaries keep the SDK extensible and testable.
project_detail.role: I developed the requirements, architecture, SwiftUI interface, authentication, AI provider integrations, persistence layer, multimodal file support, voice experience, Git-based Code Mode, SDK modularization, tests, and technical documentation.
